instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Lumina Analytics is a diversified holding company with operating businesses spanning industrial packaging, specialty chemicals, and food ingredients. The central corporate team manages strategy, M&A, and group finance across six portfolio companies, focusing on operational efficiency. The organization currently faces the challenge of integrating fragmented data streams to gain competitive insights.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: A major international competitor has signaled intent to enter our core market within the next 12 months, necessitating immediate action. We have a 6-9 month window to build competitive moats through unique value propositions and service-level improvements that would be costly for a new entrant to replicate quickly.
answers.additionalContext: The current structure lacks dedicated time for innovation, forcing initiatives to compete directly with daily operational demands. Internal communication regarding new ideas is weak, hindering cross-portfolio idea sharing.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 4-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

opportunities.title: Predictive Maintenance & Supply Chain Visibility Platform
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing operational data within the packaging and chemical divisions to implement predictive maintenance algorithms can significantly reduce unplanned downtime and operational waste. This is a low-risk, high-certainty way to improve efficiency and reduce operating costs.

first_actions: Audit current sensor and ERP data integration capabilities across the three core businesses
Identify one high-impact asset (e.g., packaging line) for a pilot program
resources_needed: Cloud SaaS subscription for basic analytics tools ($5k)
execution_plan.success_metric: 20% reduction in unplanned downtime on the pilot asset within 6 months.
milestones: Q3: Pilot program fully deployed and generating metrics

opportunities.title: Niche Specialty Ingredient Subscription Service
opportunities.rationale: Develop a highly specialized, proprietary ingredient formulation service or subscription model for the food ingredients business that competitors cannot easily replicate. This creates an exclusive customer relationship and a high barrier to entry based on intellectual property.

first_actions: Launch a dedicated R&D task force focused solely on one proprietary formulation
Conduct deep competitive analysis on existing niche ingredient providers in the market.
resources_needed: MVP development cost for digital ordering platform ($20k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 paying B2B subscription contracts within 18 months.
milestones: Q2: Proof of concept ingredient formulation complete
Q4: Subscription service fully operational and scaled

next_steps.action: Establish a formal, ring-fenced innovation steering committee and budget mechanism to move away from informal project scoping.
Initiate due diligence for the radical ingredient service idea by allocating a dedicated 'Horizon 2' exploration budget of $50k.
Implement mandatory cross-functional training on basic change management and digital adoption for the existing small team.

key_weaknesses: Informal innovation process leads to inconsistent initiative tracking and poor resource allocation.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) hinders the ability to scale insights or build necessary new service layers quickly.
Budget constraints (6% of revenue) severely limit capacity for proactive R&D and strategic platform investment.
Risk tolerance is 'balanced' but decision-making relies solely on owner-alone authority, increasing single point of failure risk.
